heading: Art. 121a. Fraudulent use of credit cards, debit cards, and other access devices

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter who, knowingly and with intent to defraud, uses— to obtain money, property, services, or anything else of value shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

children.text: a stolen credit card, debit card, or other access device;
a revoked, cancelled, or otherwise invalid credit card, debit card, or other access device; or
a credit card, debit card, or other access device without the authorization of a person whose authorization is required for such use;

tree.heading: Access Device Defined.—
tree.text: In this section (article), the term “access device” has the meaning given that term in section 1029 of title 18.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on Jan. 1, 2019, as designated by the President, with implementing regulations and provisions relating to applicability to various situations, see section 5542 of Pub. L. 114–328 and Ex. Ord. No. 13825, set out as notes under section 801 of this title.
